name: winvm-workspace
description: A scriptable Windows 11 ARM64 guest on plain QEMU + Hypervisor.framework (macOS, Apple Silicon)

scripts.check: turbo run typecheck test && bun test --parallel scripts
scripts.storybook: mise -C packages/storybook exec -- pnpm run dev
scripts.storybook:build: mise -C packages/storybook exec -- pnpm run build
scripts.storybook:check: mise -C packages/storybook exec -- pnpm run typecheck && mise -C packages/storybook exec -- pnpm run test && mise -C packages/storybook exec -- pnpm run contrast && knip --directory packages/storybook
scripts.storybook:shots: mise -C packages/storybook exec -- pnpm run build && STORYBOOK_SHOTS_CWD="${INIT_CWD:-$PWD}" mise -C packages/storybook exec -- pnpm run shots
